text: The Senezhskaya drinking-water brand is owned by Bobimex, a Russian producer of bottled water and soft drinks.
short: Bobimex owns the Senezhskaya drinking-water brand.

source.name: Forbes Russia: company profile «Бобимэкс» (archived copy)
source.note: Translation: 'Owner of the Senezhskaya deep drinking-water brand, producer of soft drinks based on it.' The page is Forbes's company profile for Bobimex.
source.quote: Владелец бренда глубинной питьевой воды «Сенежская», производитель безалкогольных напитков на ее основе
